copy.intro: {count} repositories — a native guitar workstation, a privacy-first messenger, a hardware-aware LLM picker, client work, and a few experiments that escaped the lab.

projects.title: Virtual Fantasy League
projects.description: A browser-based NHL fantasy betting league. It loads the current slate when it can, falls back to seeded demo games, and keeps members, bankrolls, bet slips, and settlement in local storage.

projects.title: Rustychops
projects.description: A native guitar-practice workstation in C# and WPF. Imports Guitar Pro and MusicXML scores, renders tab, synthesizes playback, loops tricky sections, and adds a live input meter and tuner.

projects.title: Quimby
projects.description: An experimental self-destructing messenger built on Web Crypto. Messages are encrypted before they reach the relay, expire on schedule, and decrypted text never leaves the active session.

projects.title: LLM Checker
projects.description: A hardware-aware CLI that scans your machine and recommends local models it can actually run. Ollama integration, a 55k+ model registry, and an MCP server for coding assistants. Fork of signerless/llm-checker.
projects.note: Returns 404 anonymously as of 2026-10-30. It leaves the page automatically when unreachable, and comes back as a Private card once PROJECTS_TOKEN can see it.

projects.title: C&D Cleaning Services
projects.description: A standalone website for C&D Cleaning Services, built and maintained as a straightforward marketing site for a local business.

projects.title: Hockey Heroes
